note: v2: the drift gets a shape (ground F Eb Db C, Risset pendulum, build)
v4: the hold an eighth apart on Ab, built on the eighth (hat eighths, ghost echo, bass on both guitars)
v6: the hold three sixteenths apart on B, the band only on the five coincidences
v8: the hold a sixteenth apart on C, kick and bass on every note of either guitar, the drummer in the three holes
v9: the right guitar chugs join with the bass and kick at bar 4; the band stops for the voice first word
v10: two clocks at the end, left and right, in opposition (and the snare out of the cymbals room, whole song)
